title: Summit Club Renewal Settings and Grace Periods by Membership
content:
Across the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships range, renewal periods are counted in calendar days from the membership's renewal date; the figures differ between the five renewing memberships and Summit Club Lifetime.

| Membership | New membership renews automatically unless switched off | Grace period after the renewal date (calendar days) | Renewal dues may be paid from this many calendar days before the renewal date | Membership granted as a choice benefit renews automatically at the member's expense |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Essential | Yes | 30 | 60 | No |
| Summit Club Individual | Yes | 30 | 60 | No |
| Summit Club Individual Plus | Yes | 30 | 60 | No |
| Summit Club Executive | Yes | 30 | 60 | No |
| Summit Club Corporate | Yes | 30 | 60 | No |
| Summit Club Lifetime | No | 0 | 0 | No |

## Notes

- Every membership other than Summit Club Lifetime is set to renew automatically when it is opened, unless the setting is switched off; each has a grace period of 30 calendar days after the renewal date and accepts renewal dues from 60 calendar days before the renewal date.
- Summit Club Lifetime does not renew automatically, and its grace period and early-payment period are both 0 days.
- On no membership does a membership granted as a Summit choice benefit renew automatically at the member's expense.

## Reading the figures (illustration, hypothetical renewal date 1 June)

| Membership | Earliest day renewal dues may be paid | Last day of the grace period |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Individual | 2 April (60 calendar days before 1 June) | 1 July (30 calendar days after 1 June) |
| Summit Club Corporate | 2 April | 1 July |
